How it works

Here’s how we get your project moving.

You work directly with me, from the first conversation through the finished project.

  1. 01

    Tell me what needs to change

    Send your current site, an example you like, or the task that eats up your time.

  2. 02

    Agree on the work

    You’ll know what’s included, what it costs, and what I need from you before we start.

  3. 03

    Build, test, and hand over

    We’ll check the finished work together and go through how to use it.
